name: Goaz Scrolls
summary: The librarian asks you to bring Goaz Scrolls for the collection. Your contribution adds to the library’s knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The librarian thanks you for contributing Goaz Scrolls. More magical works could help the library too, and the librarian welcomes them.

faq.answer: Goaz Scrolls add to the library’s collection and knowledge.

faq.q: Who asks for the Goaz Scrolls?
faq.answer: A librarian asks you to bring Goaz Scrolls for the collection.
The Goaz Scrolls are for the library’s collection.

faq.q: What else would benefit the library?
faq.answer: The librarian welcomes other magical works that might benefit the library.
